items.name: Teresita
items.text: Well...I just receive a very very delicious Tiramisu made by Tugce. I have to say: Is absolutely Yummy Yummy Yummy and I like it very very much. I think I’m going to eat the whole thing very soon because I can’t resist this deliciousness. They were super punctual and deliver the cake at the exact time they told me they’ll. Our communication was good and clear during the whole process, the price is outstanding because the cake is huuugeee and the item description was the same as what I receive. I REALLY REALLY RECOMMEND BUYING FROM TUGCE...I PROMISE...YOU WON’T BE DISAPPOINTED !!!
